blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu – Lapu-Lapu City is sustaining dengue prevention efforts across all its barangays while intensifying surveillance and targeted interventions in communities recording the highest number of infections. Basak topped the list of barangays with the most dengue cases, recording 354 infections and four deaths from January to November 2026. It was followed by Mactan with 283 cases and one death, Pusok with 198 cases and one death, Babag with 185 cases and one death, and Gun-ob with 176 cases. “Karun sa areas na-belong sa top 5, wala nay (additional) mortality rate,” said Dr. Niño Nero Almirante, medical coordinator for […]...
